notes.v1_04: Parasol: Simplify the lace trim into a smooth, soft cream scalloped band with no punched holes. Paint the canopy as smooth, soft matte fabric with no visible weave, with the ribs as slightly softer seams. Keep the parasol, the handle, the knob, the yellow diamond backdrop and the view.
notes.v1_07: Cake stand: Paint the tablecloth a soft mid-tone rose with smooth fabric and no weave, clearly darker than the cream stand. Make the purple wall a slightly lighter violet with a soft glow behind the stand. Give the porcelain crisp glossy highlights on the plate rims and the knob, with slightly darker plate undersides and a darker right side on the column. Keep the stand, the cakes, the striped wall and the view.
notes.v1_02: Candelabra: Paint the flames as clean, simple stylized teardrops with only a small, tight warm glow. Paint the brass as smooth warm gold with a few broad, soft highlights in place of the many small sharp reflections. Give the candles a soft warm lit side and a slightly darker right side. Keep the candelabra, the teal backdrop, the floor shadow and the view.
notes.v1_06: Folding Fan: Paint the pleats a slightly deeper rose pink, lit from the upper left, with a bright face and a darker face on each pleat and the right half gently darker. Replace the realistic lace with a smooth, soft cream scalloped band made of a few broad shapes. Add a soft shadow of the fan down and to the right on a slightly deeper blue wave backdrop. Keep the fan, the sticks, the gold pin and the view.
